Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory tests, such as sodium/potassium blood levels or blood sugar levels, may be conducted before or after taking this medication. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. Missed Dose: If you are unable to consume the entire dose of this product and the clear liquids as directed, contact your doctor immediately. Storage: Store this product at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Uses: Sodium picosulfate/magnesium oxide/citric acid solution is used to cleanse the intestines before surgery or certain procedures, such as colonoscopy or X-rays. It is a laxative that works by drawing large amounts of water into the intestines and stimulating the colon, resulting in watery bowel movements (diarrhea). How to Use: Read the Medication Guide and, if available, the Instructions for Use provided by your pharmacist before starting this product and each time you get a refill. Follow all instructions from your doctor or the manufacturer before taking this product. Adhere to any special dietary instructions provided by your doctor. Typically, you may only consume clear liquids the day before your procedure. Avoid milk, other dairy products, red/dark-colored liquids, and alcohol. To prevent dehydration, drink as much clear liquid as possible before, during, and after taking this medication. Include a variety of clear liquids, as directed by your doctor, in addition to water. Take this product in two separate doses as directed by your doctor. Follow your doctor’s instructions carefully regarding the timing of each dose. This product is available as a powder in packets that must be mixed with water before use or as a liquid in bottles that is ready to drink. Follow the specific instructions for your product. If using the powder packets, mix each dose with 5 ounces (150 milliliters) of cold water just before use. Watery bowel movements typically begin 2 to 4 hours after consuming the medication. This is normal and indicates that the medication is working. Do not take any other oral medications within one hour before starting this product, as your body may not absorb them properly. Certain medications, such as digoxin, iron, tetracycline antibiotics, quinolone antibiotics (e.g., ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin), chlorpromazine, or penicillamine, should not be taken within 2 hours before or 6 hours after using this product. Side Effects: Frequent, very watery bowel movements are expected after consuming this product. Nausea, vomiting, bloating, headache, or stomach/abdominal cramps may also occur. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, they have determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. This medication can cause excessive loss of fluids and salts, leading to dehydration. A severe allergic reaction to this drug is rare. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before taking this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you have any allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that can cause allergic reactions or other problems. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly needed.
